<!-- en -->
v0.1.2-rc.1 is the first prerelease of v0.1.2. It adds a provider dimension to `query`, makes provider aliases safe presentation-only mappings, and records default providers for newly collected sessions whose client source is known. Because prereleases are not selected by default, update explicitly with `token-usage update --version v0.1.2-rc.1`.

### Added
- `token-usage query provider` groups usage by provider and reports requests, input, output, cache read, reasoning, total tokens, and cache-hit rate
- Config TUI support for provider aliases, displayed as “Provider aliases / 供应商别名”

### Changed
- Provider aliases affect only query-time provider display and aggregation. They never alter the stored raw messages or backfill historical empty provider values
- Alias keys and values retain their case; only leading and trailing whitespace is removed. Saved aliases use TOML basic strings with double quotes so keys such as `OpenCode-Completions` are consistently represented
- Newly collected records receive source-based provider defaults when the source is known: Codex uses `OpenAI`, Claude Code/Desktop uses `Anthropic`, and WorkBuddy uses `WorkBuddy`. Existing records with no provider remain unattributed
- ZCode provider names are read from its configuration, including names such as `OpenCode-Completions`, instead of falling back to its provider UUID when the configuration supplies a name

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users can update in place with `token-usage update --version v0.1.2-rc.1`; `update` without `--version` continues to resolve only stable releases.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.2-rc.1 是 v0.1.2 的第一个预发布版。新增 `query` 的供应商维度，让供应商别名成为安全的仅展示映射，并为来源可确定的新采集记录写入默认供应商。预发布版不会被默认选中，请用 `token-usage update --version v0.1.2-rc.1` 显式升级。

### 新增
- `token-usage query provider` 按供应商汇总用量，展示请求数、输入、输出、缓存读取、推理、总计和缓存命中率
- config TUI 新增供应商别名配置，显示为“Provider aliases / 供应商别名”

### 变更
- 供应商别名只影响查询时的供应商展示与聚合，绝不修改已存储的原始消息，也不回填历史空供应商
- 别名 key 和 value 保留大小写，仅移除前后空白；保存时统一使用 TOML 双引号基本字符串，因此 `OpenCode-Completions` 等 key 会稳定呈现
- 新采集记录在来源可确定时写入默认供应商：Codex 使用 `OpenAI`，Claude Code/Desktop 使用 `Anthropic`，WorkBuddy 使用 `WorkBuddy`。既有的空供应商记录仍保持未归因
- ZCode 从配置读取供应商名称；配置提供名称时（包括 `OpenCode-Completions`）不再回退展示供应商 UUID

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户可 `token-usage update --version v0.1.2-rc.1` 原地升级；不带 `--version` 的 `update` 仍只解析稳定版。
